item.title: [LU-17049] Check supplementary groups for "enable_*_gid" settings
item.description:
The "mdt.*.enable_remote_dir_gid" parameter is intended to keep advanced functionality out of the hands of users that might abuse them. Typically this is "0" (root only) or "-1" (all users), but it is possible to set a numeric GID to allow sysadmins in a "wheel" or "admin" group to access this functionality on behalf of users.

However, it appears that the code that is checking this parameter is only checking the primary GID of the RPC against the parameter, instead of using "lustre_in_group_p()" to check all of the supplementary groups of the user, if it is not the primary one.

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

I wasn't able to get the checks on the MDS to run properly with a supplementary group just with runas -G ..., because that only sets the supplementary groups on the client, but if the MDS has l_getidentity configured then it doesn't find those groups locally. So I changed the test to actually add a supplementary GID to one of the test UIDs on the MDS.

Probably it makes sense to skip_env the test if the group does not exist for that user and there is an error adding it?
